title.en: Why a wrong guess costs more on a wide core

description.zh: 一次猜错要扔掉的是「拍数 × 每拍条数」：Zen 5 约 15 拍、每拍 8 条，95% 的准确率就丢掉一半以上的时间。
description.en: A wrong guess throws away cycles × width: about 15 cycles at 8 per cycle on Zen 5, so 95% accuracy loses more than half the time.

title.zh: 1 位与 2 位饱和计数器、排序数组为什么快
title.en: 1-bit and 2-bit counters; why the sorted array is faster

description.zh: 2 位计数器要错两次才改主意，循环出口只错一次；排好序的数组让 if 变得可猜，无分支写法则根本不猜。
description.en: A 2-bit counter needs two misses to change its mind, so a loop exit costs one miss; sorting makes the if predictable, and branchless code does not guess at all.

zh: 为什么排序后的数组处理更快
en: why is processing a sorted array faster

description.zh: 把最近几条分支的结果和地址异或起来查表，相关的分支就能互相提示；表太小时历史越长反而越乱。
description.en: XOR the outcomes of recent branches with the address to index the table, so correlated branches inform each other; in a small table longer history only dilutes it.

description.zh: 几张表各用几何级数长度的历史并带标记，最长的命中说了算；同样存储下比 gshare 准。
description.en: Several tagged tables with geometric history lengths; the longest hit decides, and at equal storage it beats gshare.

zh: 现代 CPU 怎么做分支预测

title.zh: 分支目标缓冲与返回地址栈
title.en: Branch target buffer and return address stack

description.zh: 方向猜对还不够，还要知道跳到哪：BTB 记目标，返回栈记函数返回地址，栈不够深就开始猜错。
description.en: Direction is not enough; the target must be known too: the BTB remembers targets and the return stack return addresses, which go wrong when calls nest deeper than the stack.

description.zh: 每拍能发几条取决于指令之间的依赖；按顺序发射时宽了也用不上，乱序才吃得到并行。
description.en: How many instructions issue per cycle depends on dependences between them; in-order issue cannot use extra width, out-of-order can.

title.zh: 乱序执行与寄存器重命名

description.zh: 把架构寄存器改名到物理寄存器，假依赖（WAR、WAW）消失，只剩真依赖；准备好的指令先走。
description.en: Renaming architectural registers onto physical ones removes false dependences (WAR, WAW), leaving only true ones; ready instructions go first.

title.zh: 重排序缓冲与精确异常
title.en: The reorder buffer and precise exceptions

description.zh: 乱序执行、按序提交：ROB 从头部按顺序认账，猜错或出错时把后面的全部作废，程序看起来像一条条执行。
description.en: Execute out of order, commit in order: the ROB retires from its head, and on a mispredict or fault everything younger is discarded, so the program appears sequential.

title.en: How big the out-of-order window is

description.zh: Zen 5 448、Lion Cove 576：窗口越大越能藏住缓存缺失，但每几百条就有一次猜错，窗口再大也填不满。
description.en: Zen 5 448, Lion Cove 576: a bigger window hides more cache misses, but with a mispredict every few hundred instructions it never fills.

title.zh: Spectre：猜测为什么会泄露秘密

description.zh: 猜错的指令结果被扔掉，但它们读过的缓存行留下了；用页面里的玩具机器看越界读怎样经由计时泄露，以及 lfence 和下标掩码怎么堵。
description.en: Results of wrongly guessed instructions are discarded, but the cache lines they touched remain; a toy machine on the page shows how an out-of-bounds read leaks through timing, and how lfence and index masking stop it.

title.zh: 分支预测与推测执行的前沿（截至 2026 年 11 月）
title.en: The frontier of prediction and speculation (as of November 2026)

description.zh: 新的预测器还在比赛，新的推测执行漏洞还在出现：Branch Privilege Injection、Branch Target Reuse，以及它们的补丁代价。
description.en: New predictors still compete and new speculation flaws keep appearing: Branch Privilege Injection, Branch Target Reuse, and what their fixes cost.

title.zh: 看一段代码时问三件事
title.en: Three questions about a piece of code

description.zh: 分支能不能猜、依赖链有多长、缺失能不能重叠。
description.en: Can its branches be predicted, how long are its dependence chains, can its misses overlap.
